adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-series deletion logic (the `if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)` block) was moved inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference) { ... }`. That block iterates over *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(type.endsWith("_calendar"))` and for each credential iterates `updatedBookings`, deleting one calendar ref per updated booking via `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`. With multiple `_calendar` references on the booking, this causes the full cross-credential deletion sweep to run once per reference (duplicate delete attempts). Additionally, using `find` means only the first calendar reference on each updated booking is deleted, leaving other calendar references untouched.
